b6_reason: (a) radial bundles in roots, (b) closed conjoint bundles lack cambium, (c) open bundles have cambium between xylem and phloem and (d) dicot stem protoxylem is endarch are all standard facts, so (a), (b), (c) and (d) is chosen.
b6_note: Statement (e) (monocot root usually polyarch, more than six xylem bundles) also appears correct by standard textbook text, so all five statements read as true and no option is exclusively right. Question looks faulty/ambiguous; picked the set of four most strictly definitional statements. Options 2 and 4 are equally defensible on this reading.
